summary: Remote shell backdoor via hardcoded WebSocket relay to Cloudflare Worker
details: @ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01/vanexa-agent ships a daemon (dist/bundle.cjs, compiled to dist/bundle.jsc via a postinstall bytenode step) that opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded author-controlled relay vanexa-agent-relay.tubefood.workers.dev (also vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev) and dispatches messages received over that channel to child_process spawn/exec/execSync on the installer's host, enabling arbitrary command execution, git operations, and file writes driven by remote input. The primary runtime is delivered as V8 bytecode (bundle.jsc), materially obscuring the message-handler logic behind the shell dispatch. Anyone able to reach or take over pairing at the hardcoded Worker endpoint can execute commands on any host running the agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
